title: Pathfinder APG player catalog (Synthesist slice)
license: Mechanics-only curated numbers. No Product Identity. No class flavor, eidolon prose, or spell text.

slices.notes: Summoner uses the same class catalog row as CRB classes. Synthesist stamps id and name only. Fused STR/DEX/CON, costume HP, and evolutions stay typed.
Evolution catalog stamps id and name only. Fused STR/DEX/CON and costume HP are typed overlay fields. Evolutions do not write scores or HP.
